why: This is a single-use instructional-design prioritization framework for resolving multimedia guideline conflicts, not a general theory of learning, a reusable research method, or a canonical learning-theory variant.
RFPETM is a setting-specific pharmacology course design implemented at one university, not a general learning theory or an independently adoptable programme package.

RFETM is a setting-specific reform of basic medical experimental teaching with institution-derived projects, syllabus, assessment, conditions, and textbooks rather than a general instructional element.
This is a domain-specific virtual simulation used for pre-class experimental preparation, so its evidence belongs on the canonical Simulation page rather than establishing a new element.
This is a study-specific implementation for medical undergraduates that requires fixed groups of four and experimental guidance teachers, rather than a general reusable pattern.
This is an education-specific predictive learning-analytics method using random forests and Boruta feature selection to identify achievement predictors, not a general theory of learning.
name: All-inclusive machine learning approach to modeling achievement predictors
